sentences.text: 2 . The present petition is filed under Section-482 Cr.P.C. seeking quashing of the proceeding arising out of 1.C.C. Case No. 39/2022 corresponding to Gop P.S. Case No.320/2022, further corresponding to G.R. Case No.604/2022 for the offences under Sections- 498-A/ 420/ 323/ 294/506/379/34 IPC pending before the learned J.M.F.C., Konark.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioner No.1-Sangram Mohanty is the son-in-law of the Opposite Party No.2.
The matrimonial dispute is settled between the parties and the daughter of the opposite party No.2 started living with the petitioner No.1.
Therefore, she seeks indulgence of this Court to quash the criminal prosecution lodged against the petitioners.

4. Issue notice to the opposite party No.2 by registered post/ speed post with A.D., requisites for which shall be filed within three working days.
5.
6. The parties may file their joint affidavit before this Court by next date of hearing and appear before this Court on 12.02.2024.
